verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Sprinto trust center, so there is no evidence that public-facing subprocessor lists, document renewals or control status sync from the platform. A trust center is a fair axis for a compliance automation platform. Continuous monitoring and live dashboards are internal posture features, and the GitHub skill's generated sub-processor register is a one-off document pack, not an auto-updating trust center, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand
